proceedings.supporting_quote: On 13 September 2016 the Aliens Office, the administrative body responsible for issuing visas... refused to grant “humanitarian visas” to the applicants
On 7 October 2016 the Aliens Appeals Board, acting under the extremely urgent procedure, ordered a stay of execution of the refusals by the Aliens Office
the Aliens Office issued new decisions, dated 10 October 2016, refusing to grant the visas
Aliens Appeals Board’s judgment of 20 October 2016, which had instructed the Belgian authorities to issue them with the visas they had requested
On 17 October 2016 the Aliens Office again took decisions refusing to issue the visas
Brussels Court of Appeal’s judgment of 7 December 2016 ordering the Belgian State to execute the Aliens Appeals Board’s judgment

proceedings.deciding_body: the Brussels French-language Court of First Instance
proceedings.supporting_quote: By an order of 25 October 2016... the acting president of the French-language TPI ordered the State... to comply with the Board’s judgment of 20 October 2016

proceedings.deciding_body: the Brussels French-language Court of First Instance
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 7 November 2016 another judge acting as president of the French-language TPI declared their application admissible but unfounded
The applicants subsequently submitted such an application, which was rejected by the Belgian authorities in December 2016
On an appeal by the applicants, the Brussels Court of Appeal delivered a judgment on 7 December 2016 varying the order of 7 November 2016

proceedings.deciding_body: President of the Brussels Dutch-speaking TPI
proceedings.supporting_quote: lodged a unilateral action to that effect with the President of the Brussels Dutch ‑ speaking TPI on 13 December 2016, but was unsuccessful (order of the same date)
on an appeal by the Belgian State, the court of appeal varied the decision of the first-instance court in a judgment of 14 December 2016
On 6 March 2017 the Aliens Appeals Board... decided in consequence to lift the stay of execution of the visa refusal decisions
On 24 March 2017 the Aliens Appeals Board dismissed the application to have those decisions set aside
By a judgment of 30 June 2017 a Dutch-language division of the Court of Appeal held that the Aliens Appeals Boards’ judgment of 20 October 2016 was no longer operative

proceedings.deciding_body: enforcement judge at the Brussels French-language TPI
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 15 December 2016 the applicants brought an action against the Belgian State before the enforcement judge at the Brussels French-language TPI... On 20 December 2017 the French-language enforcement judge... found that the case had become devoid of purpose
On 8 February 2018 the Conseil d’État dismissed an appeal on points of law by the applicants against the judgment of 6 March 2017
An administrative appeal on points of law lodged by the applicants against that judgment was dismissed by the Conseil d’État on 17 May 2018
On 27 February 2017 the Belgian State lodged an appeal on points of law against the court of appeal’s judgment of 7 December 2016. Those proceedings are currently pending.

proceedings.deciding_body: enforcement judge at the Brussels Dutch-language TPI
proceedings.supporting_quote: On the same date the Belgian State brought proceedings against the applicants before the enforcement judge at the Brussels Dutch ‑ language TPI, seeking a stay of execution
